purpose: resource-bounded zero-network adjudication of the unchanged v1 economic population and gates after preserving the consumed v1 resource failure and v2 missing intermediary-valuation gate

retained_source.reuse_rule: verify every retained response against its durable receipt and issue zero HTTP requests

universe.direct_edges: every retained current TRADING Binance Spot directed edge with MARKET support and positive lot step
universe.three_leg_paths: every direct source-to-target pair having source-to-first-intermediary, first-to-second-intermediary, and second-to-target edges with four distinct assets
universe.comparator: the greater of the exact feasible direct route and every exact feasible one-intermediary route at the same saved snapshot and size
universe.selection_rule: complete topology with no asset or route selection from price outcomes

execution_model.quantity_rounding: floor every submitted base quantity to the retained positive MARKET_LOT_SIZE step or LOT_SIZE fallback
execution_model.capacity: direct and all three path legs must fit displayed retained top quantity in all 60 snapshots
execution_model.residuals: retain source and both intermediary residuals and value each through its same-snapshot conservative direct-to-USDT side after one taker fee
execution_model.incremental_savings_definition: exact three-leg ending USDT-equivalent value versus exact direct less six bips, minus the maximum of zero and every feasible exact one-intermediary saving versus direct less three bips

optimistic_prefilter.continuous_path_value: multiply all three same-snapshot displayed marginal conversion rates after three ten-bip fees without lot rounding or capacity limits
optimistic_prefilter.exact_direct_denominator: use the same exact rounded displayed-capacity direct value required by the final adjudication
optimistic_prefilter.residual_upper_bound: add exactly one bip of starting USDT value because every accepted exact path must satisfy the frozen combined residual gate
optimistic_prefilter.shorter_comparator_lower_bound: use zero incremental bips although the exact best shorter comparator can only be greater or equal
optimistic_prefilter.intermediary_valuation_gate: both intermediary assets must have finite same-snapshot direct-to-USDT marginal rates because exact residual valuation is mandatory
optimistic_prefilter.lossless_rejection_proof: an exact candidate cannot exceed continuous unrounded path output plus its one-bip permitted residual; replacing the best-shorter comparator with zero and adding positive numeric padding can only increase its apparent incremental economics
survivor_requires: finite optimistic upper bounds in all 60 snapshots
strictly positive optimistic upper bound in at least 48 of 60 snapshots
at least 12 positive optimistic observations in each consecutive 15-snapshot block
optimistic_prefilter.post_prefilter: apply every unchanged exact v1 fee rounding capacity residual best-shorter and recurrence gate only to optimistic survivors

empirical_candidate_requires: all 60 retained snapshots evaluate with a feasible displayed-capacity direct route
all three path legs fit displayed top quantity in all 60 snapshots
combined source and two-intermediary residual value is at most one bip in all 60 snapshots
strictly positive exact incremental savings over the best shorter feasible route in at least 48 of 60 snapshots
at least 12 positive exact incremental observations in each consecutive 15-snapshot block
strictly positive exact median incremental savings across all 60 snapshots
accepted_edge_requires_additionally: an independently required legitimate same-account organic conversion without generated volume
exact same-account commissions discounts taxes filters and balances for every involved symbol
fresh finite-size depth immediately before the organic conversion
prospective paper or separately authorized owned sequential completion and failure-unwind evidence
positive recurrence across independent non-overlapping liquidity volatility and latency regimes

resource_contract.retain: all exact candidates and only the top 100 exact optimistic survivors by median incremental bips
resource_contract.discard: non-surviving prefilter rows and exact noncandidate rows outside the bounded top 100 after aggregation
resource_contract.never_discard: population counts prefilter survivor count candidate count exact candidate identities and decision

stop_rules: if zero exact candidates survive do not build or run a three-leg live collector on this retained mechanism
do not weaken the population comparator fees residual capacity stress or recurrence gates
do not treat cost savings as standalone arbitrage or create split rerouted self-matched or wash volume
do not access credentials accounts orders funds or protected capture state
